observations: Close-up of a used automatic transmission casing.
The casing is heavily used, dirty, and shows significant surface wear.
A black hose is attached to the side of the casing.

No origin markings or 'Japan' text are visible on the casing.

risks.risk: The transmission may be missing the necessary input and output shafts.
risks.proof: A photo of the complete transmission assembly with the input and output shafts attached.

risks.risk: The internal gears and synchronizers may be worn or seized.
risks.proof: A video of the transmission being shifted through all gears.

risks.risk: The transmission may be a used part from a different Lexus model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the back or side).

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the complete transmission with the input and output shafts.
Video of the transmission being shifted through all gears to check for noise and play.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
